answer: A cash and due from banks balance belongs to the "Cash and Due" product category, and its business unit tagging is owned by the Reference Data team [1][2].

sources.text:
DPM-002: Product Segregation and Business Unit Tagging (synthetic analogue) > Product categories
After loading, the product-segregation system assigns every record to one product category:

| Category | Examples |
|---|---|
| OTC derivatives | Interest-rate swaps, FX forwards traded bilaterally |
| Exchange-traded derivatives (ETD) | Listed futures and options |
| Loans | Term loans, overdrafts, trade finance |
| Deposits | Current, savings and term deposits |
| Other derivatives | Embedded and structured derivatives |
| Custody and trust | Assets held in custody or under trust |
| Cash and Due | Cash, and balances due from other banks |

DPM-002: Product Segregation and Business Unit Tagging (synthetic analogue) > Business unit and organisational tagging
- Each record is tagged with a business unit (BU), an organisational unit and its reporting keys, using the organisational hierarchy maintained by the **Reference Data team**.
- The Reference Data team owns the tagging rules and the hierarchy. Data Production Management applies them; it does not change them.

DPM-002: Product Segregation and Business Unit Tagging (synthetic analogue) > How a tagging fix is made
1. Identify the affected records, product and business dates.
2. Raise a correction request with the Reference Data team, with the effective date.
3. After the hierarchy is corrected, reprocess the affected business dates and confirm the BU totals in the report.
